posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Erik Sabrowski enters for Williams and sets down Murakami swinging to end a bases-loaded threat. Williams ties Charles Nagy's franchise record for strikeouts in a postseason game, going 5 2/3 IP, 1 H, 2 BB, 12 K, 1 HBP in a performance that will live on in Cleveland lore.

posts.author: Bobby Nightengale
posts.text: You have to score a run to win a game, but it must be a rough feeling to know your season ended because of this pitch. What a swing from José Ramírez and performance from Gavin Williams.

posts.author: Mac Cerullo
posts.text: The Red Sox announce that Caleb Durbin underwent a successful left fifth finger PIP joint reconstruction last week. The procedure was performed by Dr. Matthew Leibman at Newton-Wellesley Surgery Center in Wellesley.
posts.jp: レッドソックスが発表：Caleb Durbinが先週、左手小指PIP関節の再建手術を受けた。医師はDr. Matthew Leibman。

posts.author: Bobby Nightengale
posts.text: The Twins had a 10-18 record (.357 win percentage) against the four LCS teams this season. Vs. Cleveland: 7-6. Vs. Tampa Bay: 1-5. Vs. LA Dodgers: 0-3. Vs. Milwaukee: 2-4.
posts.jp: ツインズはリーグ優勝決定シリーズ進出4チーム相手に10勝18敗（.357）。クリーブランド相手7勝6敗、タンパベイ相手1勝5敗、LA相手0勝3敗、ミルウォーキー相手2勝4敗。
